thesis: The host introduces Paul Rabil as a seven-time champion lacrosse player and entrepreneur who co-founded the Premier Lacrosse League (PLL), a new tour-based league set to debut on June 1st. The conversation covers Rabil's athletic background, his transition from private equity to venture capital for the PLL, and his off-field initiatives including a podcast and a foundation for children with learning differences.
